summary: The exact candidate is partial test-only hardening. Its fresh gfx950 JIT GPU regression passes and its new braced divergent-barrier case covers the supplied counterexample, but the source helper still accepts the same divergent __syncthreads() behind an unbraced single-statement if. The prepared base production planner already contains the race fix, so the original failure was not reproducible there; the candidate changes no production/native source.

tests.what_was_measured: At exact candidate commit, five tests and nine subtests passed on gfx950. This included 100 repetitions of [4] * 72 + [3] * 24, warp-boundary and uniform cases, CPU/GPU plan equality, ragged-ID bounds, and the candidate's source checks. A fresh private JIT shared library was produced. Raw output: evidence/candidate-pytest.log and evidence/jit-artifacts.log.

tests.command: Invoke the candidate's _assert_warp_extrema_synchronized helper on production kernel text augmented with initialized warp extrema followed by: if (tx < kNumWarps) __syncthreads();
tests.what_was_measured: Independent adversarial failure of the regression: the helper returned successfully and printed ACCEPTED_DIVERGENT_SINGLE_STATEMENT_BARRIER although most block threads skip the block barrier. Raw output: evidence/adversarial-single-statement-barrier.log.
Candidate aggregate diff has no whitespace errors. Raw output: evidence/diff-check.log.

gpu_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 ran the real JIT planner. PyTorch imported from the prepared interpreter (2.11.0+rocm7.2), sglang imported from /job/repo/python/sglang, and the fresh extension was built under the job-private SGLANG_JIT_CACHE_DIR. See evidence/environment.log, evidence/candidate-pytest.log, and evidence/jit-artifacts.log.
native_rebuild_evidence: No production/native files differ in the exact candidate commit, and repository-environment.json has no monolithic native build. The applicable planner JIT native extension was nevertheless rebuilt from the candidate checkout into a previously unused private cache; its object and shared-library paths are recorded in evidence/jit-artifacts.log.
remaining_counterexamples: The source regression accepts initialized warp extrema followed by `if (tx < kNumWarps) __syncthreads();` without braces. Its brace-depth heuristic sees function scope, but only kNumWarps threads reach the block barrier, so the kernel can deadlock or violate block synchronization.
remaining_limitations: The original failure cannot be reproduced on the recorded prepared base because that source already removed the racy scratch initialization and has one writer per warp extrema slot followed by a block-wide barrier.
The original NVIDIA H20 CUDA TP=2 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark compact graph-capture workload was not run: this environment has one AMD gfx950 GPU and no reported model weights.

The gfx950 run qualifies planner metadata, bounds, and CPU/GPU parity on HIP; it does not qualify NVIDIA CUDA scheduling, full-model graph capture, semantic accuracy, or a distributed serving workload.
The candidate's static source helper is not a C++ parser and remains vulnerable to semantically divergent control flow that its brace-count heuristic does not recognize.
